items.html: *Also know that from the two Mochin of Hochma and Bina, called the inheritance of Aba and Ima, illumination is drawn to him in his two faces, as it is said: "May the Lord make His face shine upon you." Two faces, right and left, from the side of Hochma and from the side of Bina. But from Daat it is drawn into the body, into the halls and chambers, which are the VAK. And now the Partzuf of ZA is completed in the aspect of its inwardness, which is the fifth aspect.
